rca of the issue: Self-correction (and transitively debate/chat/daily-scan) failed solely because the shared Emergent LLM key hit its monetary budget cap (cost 1.019187 > max 1.0) returning OpenAIException RateLimitError from litellm. Reproduction: POST /api/orchestrator/self-correction -> GET /api/orchestrator/self-corrections shows status=failed error containing 'Budget has been exceeded'. Mitigation: increase budget or rotate EMERGENT_LLM_KEY, then re-run the LLM-dependent tests. No application-code fix required.
